query: When does a remote server stop existing?

Additionally, if the last card protecting a remote server or in the root of that server is uninstalled outside of the process of installing another card, the server ceases to exist during the next checkpoint [S2]. If a server ceases to exist during a run against it, the run ends after any currently open paid ability window closes [S1].
